Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics component of this study is specifically a cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) experiment designed to map the interaction interface between the Ska complex and microtubules. This is a molecular state comparison focusing on protein-protein complex assembly/binding rather than a differential treatment study of cell populations.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a structural proteomics experiment using chemical cross-linking (CXMS) to map protein-protein interfaces. Standard bottom-up pipelines for quantification are not applicable; a specialized CXMS search engine (like the mentioned 'Xi software') is required to identify crosslinked peptide pairs.
